exceptions.reason: Fixes a main-thread deadlock: all six Tauri commands ran synchronously on the UI event-loop thread, and select_project_root's native folder dialog needs that same thread's event loop to complete, so choosing a project froze the whole window. Converting each command to async and dispatching its blocking body through a shared run_blocking helper is the minimal fix; extracting the command handlers into a dedicated module is deferred to the next Desktop native-bridge change.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: Extract the Tauri command handlers from main.rs into a commands module before the next behavior change touching this file.

exceptions.reason: Fixes CodeQL alert #1 (js/polynomial-redos). A first attempt narrowed the reference regex's ambiguous \s+ to \s, but CodeQL still flagged it: the real driver is the unbounded [^)\s]+ backtracking fully on unterminated input, repeated at every subsequent `](` occurrence during the global scan. Replaced the regex with findMarkdownLinkTargets, a manual forward-scanning helper in a new markdown-links.ts module, imported here. Extracting extension validation from this file (per the still-open PR #160 exception above) remains the real decomposition follow-up.
exceptions.reviewTrigger: Extract extension validation from index.ts before the next behavior change touching this file.
